old_value: {"id":"vouch-faq3.13","title":"Forged committer dates can make history-based --at count early","description":"Review of faq3.12 (2026-10-23): query --at (tiers since faq3.11, endorsements since faq3.12) uses the first-parent committer date to decide what was in effect at TIME. Cheapest fix: clamp each first-parent commit's effective date to at least its first-parent ancestor's (monotonic), so a backdated commit cannot precede what came before it; alternatively require --no-ff merges into the registry (process, not code). Decide and record in DESIGN TRQP bridge Time.","acceptance_criteria":"Test: a commit with a committer date earlier than its parent's does not make its records count before the parent's date; DESIGN states the rule.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-23T18:28:21.868605364Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-23T18:28:21.868605364Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"vouch-faq3.13","depends_on_id":"vouch-faq3","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-23T18:28:21.8860862Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"notes":"DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-23): (c) both. Code: each first-parent commit's effective date = max(its committer date, its first-parent's effective date); check refuses (error, not warning) a commit whose committer date is more than a few minutes in the future of the check time. Process: registry maintainers merge with git merge --no-ff (guides, runbook, rehearsal) so dates are the maintainer's clock. Applies to query --at and to export valid-before from deletions. DESIGN states both."}
